# here.now Skill Configuration

**Instant web publishing for MIFECO**

Version: 1.6.3
Source: https://here.now

## Quick Start

Publish any file or folder:
```bash
./skills/here-now/scripts/publish.sh {file-or-dir}
```

## For Agents

Use the publish utility:
```javascript
const { publish } = require('./lib/herenow');

const result = await publish('./my-website');
console.log(result.siteUrl); // https://bright-canvas-a7k2.here.now/
```
